news.title: Ginger surges Tk50-60 in two days, onion and garlic also costlier

news.title: 29% of highly educated Bangladeshi youth unemployed, half work below qualifications: IMF
news.snippet: The IMF warns that skills mismatches, limited quality jobs and AI-driven changes in hiring are compounding employment challenges for young Bangladeshis.

news.title: Bangladesh's trillion-dollar dream versus reality: Can 'band-aids' fix a governance crisis?
news.snippet: The IMF projects Bangladesh’s growth to hover around 3% by FY31, as weak governance, corruption and stalled reforms threaten its $1 trillion economic ambition.

news.title: Bangladesh, IMF to work out details of loan proposal over next two weeks: Khosru

news.title: Bangladesh overtakes India in per capita GDP, but IMF sees India regaining lead in FY29
news.snippet: Bangladesh had previously maintained a higher GDP per capita than India for seven consecutive years from 2018, before India overtook it in 2025.

news.title: Fiscal year shift to April-March: Govt seeks time-bound plans to revise laws, regulations, and systems
news.snippet: The shift from July-June to April-March will require changes to laws, regulations and government systems, with ministries asked to submit time-bound plans by 25 October.

news.title: Bangladesh seeks $4.5b IMF loan in 6 instalments through 2029
